subject: S12a re-review done: 7 items + https prod gate + checklist; smoke 2x green; ink all green on CI 43971260118
body:
S12a re-review (20261116T185326-lead-8ae394) and lead rule 20261116T195755: done.

COMMITS ON claude/naadi-shared
- Earlier in this reopen: 125a2f5.
- Now: 0ed411c, eea28b1, 90844b5, fc63e19, 30b9ec9, a3b5d38, 23ad2d7, 51f2f7c.

CI
- Run 43971260118 (bebb371, contains 23ad2d7): https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43971260118
- Every ink and ink-gate test passed: chromium 113, firefox 113, webkit 132 (webkit includes ipad-portrait-dpr2 and the https prod gate).
- The run is red for reasons outside ink:
  - tests/embeddings/test_quiet_logging.py
  - exam.spec offline pause (firefox)
  - agent.spec discard and budget (firefox)
  - qbank.spec Lab values (webkit-ipad-portrait)
  - integration job: Mailpit could not bind port 54324 ("address already in use").
- 51f2f7c (shortcut guard only) has no CI run yet. The earlier queued runs 43967056774 and 43967409730 were replaced by newer pushes before they started.

LOCAL SMOKE (--retries=0, workers 2, E2E_PORT 7902)
- Set: webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440.
- Last two runs on the rebased tree: smoke-9 68 passed, smoke-10 68 passed, 0 failed.
- 8 skipped per run: the signed-in gate tests need the CI auth container.
- Earlier runs, for the record:
  - Pre-rebase smoke-7 and smoke-8 were also 68/68.
  - Failures before the fixes below were scroll ratios measured with one paired run per state at load averages 30–65, one fonts.ready stall, and timeouts at load 65.

PERF GATES
webkit-ipad-portrait-dpr2 and webkit-laptop-1440, after fc63e19 and a3b5d38:
- dpr-2 latency, paint p50 (ms): 19, 20, 18, 20, 15, against the 60 ms bound. p95: 33–104. No fallback bound needed.
- dpr-2 scroll, median ink/hidden ratio: 1.02, 0.91, 0.91, 0.89, 0.94.
- webkit-laptop-1440 scroll ratio, passing 12 of 12 runs after fc63e19: 0.86, 0.83, 0.90, 0.77, 0.83, 0.88, 0.72, 0.78, 0.92, plus the perf-7, perf-8 and perf-9 passes.
- Before fc63e19 the ratio was 0.61–0.64.
- Smoke-10 ratios: ipad-landscape 0.84, ipad-portrait 0.85, phone-390 0.99, chromium-laptop 0.99.
- Canvas budget: peak 19.65 Mpx against a 24 Mpx limit (asserted peak <= limit).

FIXES IN THIS ROUND
- Root cause of the scroll cost: the lab's sticky toolbar had no compositing layer, so WebKit repainted the whole scrolled page, ink images included, on every scroll frame. will-change: transform on the sticky wrapper fixes it.
  - Measured by toggling the ink in 250 ms slices at load 20: ratio 0.63–0.89 before, 0.91–1.11 after.
  - Canvases instead of images: 0.58–0.89, worse.
  - will-change on the images themselves: 0.41, much worse.
  - apps/web/src/practice/QuestionPage.tsx:206 has the same sticky pattern. I posted to seg08 and seg09 (20261116T210415).
- Scroll gate method:
  - Five rounds, each one continuous scroll with the ink shown and hidden in alternating slices (250 ms, or 8 frames at the rate of the previous round).
  - The first frame after each switch is not counted. A round with fewer than 12 frames per state is repeated, at most 5 extra rounds.
  - Pass: median ratio >= 0.7. The 25 fps floor applies when the ink-hidden median is >= 35.7 fps; below that the run is annotated.
  - The lab's Measure scroll button is still exercised once.
- ui_copy for all ink strings, lab included per the lead's answer 20261116T204720:
  - 132 ink.* keys in config/app_config.yaml and REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS; defaults regenerated.
  - The engine emits InkError codes and takes its labels from the host.
  - src/ink is added to noHardcodedCopy ROOTS.
  - The UiCopy bound is raised from 500 to 2000 strings: the shipped config now holds 568, and the old bound rejected it.
- Keyboard shortcuts are now ignored in dialogs, media players and focused scroll regions, as well as in editable fields. Guarded by ownsKeys(), with 5 unit tests.
- e2e:
  - fonts.ready is awaited without returning the FontFaceSet (it stalled WebKit for 58 s once). fixtures.ts:184 and :210 have the same pattern; reported in 20261116T211454.
  - Settle waits are 60 s and 90 s; they are waits, not gates.

REVIEW_CHECKLIST
- Copy: PASS. Every ink string is a ui_copy key; defaults regenerated; src/ink is in the no-hardcoded-copy test, which passes.
- Structured server fields: PASS. S12a has no server responses; engine errors are codes formatted with inkErrorText.
- One lime CTA, status not by colour alone: PASS.
  - "Ink on" is the only lime control (e2e asserts it).
  - Swatches have names and visible rings.
  - Switches show On/Off text.
  - Eraser mode and tools have text labels.
- Phone 390/412: PASS on 390 locally; 412 on CI.
  - No horizontal overflow, asserted.
  - The toolbar is one row that scrolls horizontally.
  - The selection menu is placed below or above the lasso and never covers it (asserted).
- No dead buttons: PASS. With no ink in the loop, only "Ask Naadi" is shown. Copy, Delete and Convert are hidden rather than disabled.
- Shortcuts not in inputs, dialogs, scroll regions or media: PASS (51f2f7c, unit tests; ink e2e shortcuts test 9/9).
- No leaks before an attempt: N/A for ink. The assistant is not wired here.
- RLS and server-authoritative columns: N/A. S12a has no migration; S12b owns 0009.
- Production CSP: PASS. ink-gate.spec runs against APP_ENV=prod over https loopback with zero console errors, in WebKit too. The only CSP line seen locally came from Playwright's own failure screenshot after a failed test, never in a passing run.
- PII scrubbing: N/A. The ink package makes no network calls; the no-network test allows only same-origin GET /assets/*.js.
- Free models and services only: N/A for ink.
- Tests:
  - vitest: ink 56, web 144 (src/ink 12).
  - config_api pytest: 21.
  - Clean: biome, ruff, mypy (config_api), tsc.
  - gen:contracts: no drift. gen:requirements: no dependency change.
- Smoke 2x with --retries=0: PASS (smoke-9 and smoke-10 above). CI link above.
- No races: PASS. Tests poll renderPending before measuring, and fonts are awaited without serialising.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/12a/ for iPad portrait, landscape, dpr2, phones, laptop and desktop, plus the JSON numbers. Compared with the ink board.
- Sandbox hygiene: PASS.
  - Ports 7902–7904 only.
  - I killed only processes whose command line had my worktree path.
  - Temp files are in .tmp/.
  - One self-inflicted problem: an experiment run shared the artifacts directory with a smoke run. That smoke run was discarded, and experiments now use .tmp/exp/out.

RISKS
- Real-device numbers are still the 240 fps protocol on an iPad (docs/DEVICE_CHECKLIST.md). Headless WebKit is software rendering.
- The QuestionPage sticky header likely has the same scroll cost (reported to its owners).
- Under heavy sandbox load (above 30 on 4 cores), local perf gates can still fail. CI is the judge.
